name: smwsprites-coin-stream
title: Coin Stream
description:
Originally made way back for Summer C3 2018 (when there was a patch for misc. sprite types), finally made available for new PIXI versions and submitted to the section (PIXI 1.40 and above required).

This is basically a boo stream, but instead of boos, it generates coins that can be collected. It also expires after a certain amount of time if set to.
